scope: C-011 owner/session/result-bound idempotent lighting, LightFact/DayLit transaction, replay-safe relationship projection, deletion cutoff, explicit seven-date history and Mini Program unknown-outcome recovery

T-C011-CONTRACT-001.selector: C-011 light and history transport contract
assertions: the strict light command binds command, original product date and published result while rejecting reading position and guard authority
the recent history contract represents missing dates without invented light, result or evening facts
authenticated OpenAPI light/history paths resolve to executable shared schemas

T-C011-API-001.selector: C-011 HTTP light and records flow
assertions: same light command replays one result while a changed payload conflicts
client MAIN_ACTION_REACHED claims are rejected instead of stored or trusted
recent records expose only explicit allowlisted facts and stable low-cardinality operations

T-C011-DB-001.selector: C-008 real PostgreSQL idempotent generation, publication and guard fences
assertions: real PostgreSQL 18 serializes two device light commands to one LightFact and one logical DayLit outbox
a session/result/date-bound continuation permits the original day without rewriting it to the new date
two concurrent DayLit events leave one active cycle, one encounter link and one relationship day
a released relationship deletion epoch and cutoff prevent an old light from entering a new cycle
seven product dates are newest-first and missing dates contain no fabricated facts

T-C011-QUEUE-001.selector: C-008 outbox/inbox publishes once and Redis cache loss rebuilds from PostgreSQL
assertions: real Redis 8 and BullMQ 5 route DayLit only to the background-relationship capability
the PostgreSQL 18 InboxReceipt and EncounterLink commit before BullMQ acknowledgement
one DayLit event produces one inbox receipt and one relationship link
valid source revision and guard epochs update a deterministic relationship projection
replay returns the existing link without advancing the projection
stale epochs and post-deletion cutoff sources are rejected
unknown light outcome stores one bounded command and reads authoritative interaction before any retry
an already successful unknown request is not submitted a second time
offline history uses only a validated cache whose missing days remain fact-free
task status and lighting remain independent
